newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Informatics ups business training centres.
newsitem.headline: Informatics ups business training centres.

text.p: Informatics Holdings said on Thursday it was opening more business training centres under the Thames brand name, which will bring the total under Thames to 18 in six countries by 1997.
Informatics operates franchises for centres that run information technology (IT) and business training and education.
The three centres to be opened by 1997 are in the Burmese capital Rangoon using a joint venture, along with one in Malacca, Malaysia and Jakarta, Indonesia, officials said at a news conference.
Three more centres are targeted in Indonesia by 1998.

Informatics derives about 20 percent of its turnover from Thames, 75 percent from its information technology centres and the remainder from other products and services, said company chairman and chief executive officer, Wong Tai.
